 TEAM NEWS: Southampton (A)
 Derby County’s line-up for their 12.30pm Sky Bet Championship kick-off against Southampton has been confirmed. 
 Head Coach John Eustace has made one alteration to the side that beat Bolton Wanderers 3-1 before the international break.
 Alex Mowatt returns to the starting line-up in the absence of Lewis Travis, with Carlton Morris leading the line and taking on captain’s duties.
 Matt Clarke, who sustained an injury in the Rams’ first competitive game of the 2026/27 season, returns to the matchday squad on the bench at St Mary’s.
 Henrik Meister comes back into the fold on the bench after missing the Bolton match. While Joe Ward is also named amongst the substitutes after a period on the sidelines.
 Derby County: Zetterström (GK), Ozoh, Clark, Morris (C), Brewster, Robinson, Fuseini, Mowatt, Nyambe, Duffy, Sanderson.
 Substitutes: Vickers (GK), Clarke, Bilbija, Salvesen, Meister, Johnston, Ward, Fraulo, Blackett-Taylor.
